events.verdict: Jackson Jr. (MEM) briefly engages with Gay (SAS), but doesn't affect his FOM.
Holiday (MEM) legally contests Bertans' (SAS) jump shot attempt.
Valanciunas (MEM) firms up on his right foot and absorbs the contact from DeRozan (SAS) during the pick.
DeRozan (SAS) makes contact with Wright's (MEM) right wrist after the release of his jump shot attempt, but does not affect his ability to follow through naturally.
Valanciunas (MEM) briefly has his arm around Aldridge's (SAS) midsection and makes contact that is tactile in nature.
LLB shows DeRozan (SAS) initiates contact with Valanciunas' (MEM) right arm during his upward shooting motion.
Valanciunas (MEM) and Aldridge (SAS) engage and disengage off-ball without affecting the other's ability to freely move.
Aldridge (SAS) makes marginal contact to Valanciunas (MEM) in the post, but does not affect his ability to defend.
Valanciunas (MEM) briefly engages with Aldridge (SAS) in the post, but doesn't affect his ability to maintain position.

Valanciunas (MEM) commits the intentional foul on Aldridge (SAS) after his gather. The crew communicated with the Replay Center to determine if the foul met the criteria for a flagrant foul. After review, it was determined that Valanciunas would be assessed a common foul.
DeRozan (SAS) attempts to get around the screen and briefly places his hand on Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) opposite side hip before correcting.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) establishes himself in a screening position in DeRozan's (SAS) defensive path and does not deliver the contact.
Aldridge (SAS) slightly steps into Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) landing area, but the contact is marginal and doesn't affect his ability to land safely or naturally.
Bradley (MEM) briefly puts his arm to Gay's (SAS) midsection and then corrects. From the RATR, it appears that his right arm starts in front of Gay, but Gay throws it off.
Holiday (MEM) legally contests DeRozan's (SAS) jump shot attempt.
DeRozan (SAS) gathers the ball, comes to a legal jump stop and maintains his pivot foot throughout the jump shot attempt.
LAR shows Aldridge (SAS) and Jackson Jr. (MEM) lock up under the rim, and when the ball come to Aldridge, Jackson Jr. does not disengage and affects his ability to rebound.
Jackson Jr. (MEM) does not bring his hand under the ball as he legally maintains his dribble.
Aldridge (SAS) initially makes clean contact with the ball, but then slides his hand off onto Jackson Jr.'s (MEM) hand and right arm, affecting his driving shot attempt.
Bradley (MEM) makes marginal contact with Aldridge (SAS) during the inbound.
